title.narrative: Advancing Disaster Risk Reduction and Climate Adaptation in Africa: Preventing Loss and Damage and Enhancing Urban Resilience
Promuovere la riduzione del rischio di disastri e l'adattamento al clima in Africa: Prevenire perdite e danni e migliorare la resilienza urbana

description.narrative: L’iniziativa in oggetto è strutturata in due componenti tra loro complementari: la prima è costituita da un contributo di un milione di euro a favore del trust fund multi-donatore di GFDRR per supportare l’agenda loss and damage; la seconda contribuisce con un milione di euro al trust fund multi-donatore denominato City Resilient Program così da rafforzare la resilienza e l’adattamento dei centri urbani in Africa Occidentale. Il City Resilient Program si basa su tre pilastri: Pianificazione per la resilienza, Finanza per la resilienza e Partenariati per la resilienza.

This initiative is structured in two complementary components: the first is a EUR 1 million contribution to the GFDRR multi-donor trust fund to support the loss and damage agenda; the second is a EUR 1 million contribution to the multi-donor trust fund called City Resilient Program to strengthen the resilience and adaptation of urban centres in West Africa. The City Resilient Program achieves its goals through three pillars: Planning for Resilience, Finance for Resilience and Partnerships for Resilience.

tag.narrative: By 2020, substantially increase the number of cities and human settlements adopting and implementing integrated policies and plans towards inclusion, resource efficiency, mitigation and adaptation to climate change, resilience to disasters, and develop and implement, in line with the Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction 2015–2030, holistic disaster risk management at all levels

By 2030, significantly reduce the number of deaths and the number of people affected and substantially decrease the direct economic losses relative to global gross domestic product caused by disasters, including water-related disasters, with a focus on protecting the poor and people in vulnerable situations
Ensure responsive, inclusive, participatory and representative decision-making at all levels
Integrate climate change measures into national policies, strategies and planning
Make cities and human settlements inclusive, safe, resilient and sustainable
Promote peaceful and inclusive societies for sustainable development, provide access to justice for all and build effective, accountable and inclusive institutions at all levels
Strengthen resilience and adaptive capacity to climate-related hazards and natural disasters in all countries
Support least developed countries, including through financial and technical assistance, in building sustainable and resilient buildings utilizing local materials
Take urgent action to combat climate change and its impacts
